method: Counts are case-insensitive literal substring occurrences in the exact file bytes decoded as UTF-8; source identity is pinned by register commit b142cf88d389e791160f691aac3d936852b99975 and SHA-256. The register's CONTROL_STATE.json declares terminal_runtime_local_path = _archive/hl_stage2/HL_Live_Copy_Service.py as the authoritative runtime. This census establishes presence of lease primitives (msvcrt, fcntl, instance.lock, acquire_instance_lock) in the Core engine and their complete absence in the declared runtime.
notes: Core engine PID count (20) includes occurrences in docstrings and comments, not lease-holder logic.
Declared runtime PID count (1) is a single occurrence in a comment, not a lease mechanism.
The register's source_sha256 map entries are tracked under a different path namespace (local-trading/Hyperliquid scanner/...); this census uses the CONTROL_STATE.json declared paths.
